title: Fantasque Sans Mono Custom Build Configuration

LargeLineHeight.description: Increases line height metric for better accented character rendering.

NoLoopK.description: Uses a straight, non-looped variant for lowercase 'k'.

UseHinted.description: Runs ttfautohint on generated TTF fonts for screen rendering optimization.

EnableMultiWeight.description: Enables multi-weight interpolation (Medium 500, SemiBold 600) from harmonized masters before the legacy variant pipeline. Recorded in the manifest as audit information only — packaging does not consume it (Spec §4.10, r4 R1).
